senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of נַחֲלָה , q. v.) to inherit.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:1">B. Bath. VIII, 1</cite> <he>יש נוֹחֲלִין ומַנְחִילִין</he> there are such relations as inherit from and eventually transmit to one another (e. g. father and son); <he>ויש נוחלין ולא מנחילין</he> and some inherit, but (when they die) do not transmit their estate to those whose natural heirs they would have been (e. g. son and mother).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:10">Kidd. I, 10</cite> <he>ונוֹחֵל את הארץ</he> and shall inherit the land (of life everlasting).
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 133:4">Sifré Num. 133</cite> <he>יודע</he> … <he>שהבנות נוֹחֲלוֹת</he> Moses knew that daughters (in the absence of sons) are legal heirs.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 5:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. V</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 21:19">Num. XXI, 19</cite>) <he>משנָחֲלוּ ע״ז בא עליהם וכ׳</he> when they adopted idolatry, the angel of death came upon them.

<cite ref="Numbers 21:19">Ib.</cite> <he>נחלו להק״בה לאלוה והוא נ׳ וכ׳</he> they adopted the Lord as God, and he adopted them as a people; <cite ref="Numbers 21:19">ib.</cite> <he>ממתנה נָחַלְתִּי לאל</he> through the gift (of the well in the desert) I adopted God; <he>מתוך שנתן לי הקב״ה הבאר נחלתי אותו</he> (ed. Bub.) because the Lord gave me the well as a gift, I adopted him; <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:24">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>וכיון שניתנה לו במתנה נְחָלוֹ אל</he> and since it (the Law) is given him as a gift, the Lord claims him as his own; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to transmit by legal succession; to give in possession. B. Bath. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 11:32">Tosef. B. Mets. XI, 32</cite>, a. fr. <he>שעל מנת כן ה׳ וכ׳</he> for Joshua gave possession of the land with such provisions (restricting the rights of ownership).

<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:12">Ukts. III, 12</cite> <he>עתיד הקב״ה להַנְחִיל וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100a:6">Snh. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>ליתן</he>) the Lord will in the hereafter give every righteous man possession of &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 114b:3">B. Bath. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>אין הבן יורש את אמו בקבר להנחיל וכ׳</he> a son in the grave does not succeed his mother so as to transmit his estate to his paternal brothers; a. fr.
